Class ChaosOpenTelemetry

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.opentelemetry.ChaosOpenTelemetry
public final class ChaosOpenTelemetry extends Object
Publishes chaos activity through the OpenTelemetry API: metrics, and span events that mark the traced requests chaos hit. 
ChaosOpenTelemetry.Registration metrics =
    ChaosOpenTelemetry.metrics(ChaosPlatform.current(), openTelemetry);
ChaosOpenTelemetry.Registration spans = ChaosOpenTelemetry.spanEvents(ChaosPlatform.current());

Metrics (instrumentation scope "com.macstab.chaos.jvm"); every instrument has one fixed attribute set:

  • chaos.events — counter of every chaos event: chaos.event.type
  • chaos.applications — counter of effects that took effect: chaos.scenario.id, chaos.operation, chaos.effect
  • chaos.injected.delay — histogram (unit s, double) of the latency the agent added, from the event's delayNanos: chaos.scenario.id, chaos.operation
  • chaos.skips — counter of matches the policy kept from applying: chaos.scenario.id, chaos.skip.reason
  • chaos.activation.failures — counter: chaos.failure.category
  • chaos.scenarios — gauge of registered scenarios: chaos.scenario.state
  • chaos.listener.events.dropped — counter of events dropped by full asynchronous listener queues
  • chaos.hooks.woven — gauge of hook groups woven into JDK and library classes

Attribute values: chaos.operation is the OperationType name in lower case (thread_sleep); chaos.effect is the effect's plan JSON type (delay, connectionReset), derived from the event's effectType, the effect class's simple name: without its Effect suffix, first letter lower-cased.

chaos.applications, chaos.injected.delay and chaos.skips keep chaos.scenario.id: the API cannot retire a series, so their cardinality is bounded only by the SDK's cardinality limit; drop the attribute with a View where scenario ids are many.

Counters and the histogram are fed on an agent-owned thread (ChaosEventListener.async(ChaosEventListener)); span events are added on the application thread, synchronously, because the current span lives there.
